decision_rationale: This is a primary generative genomics model paper, but the only “text” described is biological mutation strings, not natural-language text. The record supports generation with GPT-like models, but not a substantive text component or text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: “encoding each mutation as a string 'CHR : POS : REFs > ALTs GT'”; “We focused on generative models for Causal Language Modelling (CLM)”; “GPT-like transformer-based models are valid generators of synthetic genomic samples”
